verdict.rationale: Antigravity's desktop app (confirmed as a VSCode-style editor) ships a dedicated 'Review Changes' diff viewer with whitespace filtering and syntax-highlighted artifacts (antigravity-docs-33, -34, -30), plus explicit support for running multiple agents/sessions in parallel across independent projects and worktrees from one command center (antigravity-docs-1, -37, -38, -10). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the side-by-side multi-session UI specifically (community evidence mostly discusses general bugs/instability rather than this feature directly).
